description: Clean up an AI-made sprite sheet or a set of animation frames: removes the background, finds each frame, makes the character the same height in every frame, lines up the feet and the body, and packs everything into an even grid. Returns the sheet PNG and frame data (cell size, columns, rows, and a TexturePacker-style JSON). Runs on this computer and saves the results as files.

cell.description: Square cell size in pixels. Default: fits the biggest frame.

columns.description: Columns in the output sheet. Default: all frames in one row.

grid.description: If the frames sit in a regular grid, give it as "COLSxROWS", e.g. "4x2". Otherwise each frame is found on its own.

match_colors.description: Pull the colours of every frame toward the first one.

out_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: next to the input file.

path.description: Full path of a PNG or JPG file on this computer. With a GameShipKit Pro key (GAMESHIPKIT_KEY) it can also be a folder, and every image in it is processed.

pixel_art.description: Scale with sharp pixels instead of smooth.

same_height.description: Scale frames so the body is the same height in each.

name: sprite_sheet
title: Clean sprite sheet
